analysis_steps.goal: Image cubes and apply moment mask

method.value: Image in CASA; moment-masked cube to zero emission-free pixels

evidence.quote: The moment masked cube has zero values at the emission free pixels, which is useful to avoid a large error arising from the random noise.

validation.value: Compared with Mopra: ~30% of ALMA flux missing at 45"

evidence.quote: About 30$\%$ of the ALMA flux is missing when smoothed to 45" and compared to the Mopra observations.

analysis_steps.goal: Decompose into leaves/trunks and measure properties

method.value: astrodendro on 12CO and 13CO cubes; radius R=1.91 sigma_r, sigma_v from second moment, L_CO from summed flux; bootstrap errors

evidence.quote: The rms radius in the second spatial moments obtained from *astrodendro* is converted into the radius of a spherical cloud $R=1.91\sigma_r$ (cite: solomon87).
We use 100 iterations to sample the derived parameters.

method.value: Fit size-linewidth, sigma^2/R vs surface density, virial mass-luminosity (X_CO), and differential mass spectra dN/dM ∝ M^-alpha for leaves and trunks

evidence.quote: in our analysis we use the differential form of clump mass spectrum i.e. $dN/dM = f(M)$.

findings_qualitative.value: N 55 clumps are in self-gravitational virial equilibrium with negligible external pressure; star-forming cores have larger linewidths and masses.

evidence.quote: These findings indicate that N 55 clumps are in self-gravitational virial equilibrium with negligible external pressure.

claims.result: Ratio 1.12; clumps lie on virial equilibrium line
claims.finding: Clumps bound with negligible external pressure

evidence.quote: These results indicate that most of the star-forming and non-star-forming cores are gravitationally bound.

evidence.quote: This power-law behavior of the core mass function in N 55 is consistent with many Galactic clouds.
